summary: True-peak lookahead limiter: input gain drives the signal into a ceiling in dBTP, detected 4× oversampled as BS.1770 measures it, so the output's true peak stays under the ceiling. Program-dependent (auto) or set release, stereo link. v2's stages, each off by default (as v1): upward compression, transient emphasis, a 4× soft clip, a two-stage release, transient unlink, Unity listen and Delta; the "Style —" presets set them. Use it last on the master to reach a loudness target without overs, or to catch peaks on a bus.
use_for: True-peak limiting for loudness and safe peaks on the master or a bus.

parameters.name: Input gain
parameters.description: Gain into the limiter in 0.1 dB steps: raises loudness by pushing the signal into the ceiling

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: The output's true-peak limit (dBTP), 0.1 dB steps

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time for 63 % of a reduction to recover; with Auto release, the time sustained limiting recovers in (short peaks recover faster)

parameters.name: Auto release
parameters.description: Program-dependent release: short peaks recover fast, sustained limiting slowly (less distortion on dense material)

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: The gain starts falling this long before a peak arrives (longer: smoother, less distortion; adds latency)

parameters.name: Stereo link
parameters.description: 100 %: both channels get the same gain (the image stays put); 0 %: each channel on its own

parameters.name: Upward
parameters.description: Upward compression before the limiter (v2): quiet passages lifted by up to this much, half a dB for each dB their 3 s RMS sits under Upward threshold. 0 dB: off (as v1)

parameters.name: Upward threshold
parameters.description: The RMS level (dBFS, after Input gain) under which Upward lifts

parameters.name: Transients
parameters.description: Transient emphasis (v2): the first milliseconds of hits raised by up to this much before the limiter (the shared transient/sustain split), so limiting keeps their punch. 0 dB: off

parameters.name: Soft clip
parameters.description: A soft clip before the limiter (v2), 4× oversampled with anti-aliasing: the curve bends from this far under the ceiling, so the limiter does less. Off: as v1 (adds 58 samples of latency when on)

parameters.name: Clip mix
parameters.description: How much of the soft clip is heard (the rest the signal unclipped, delayed to match); the ceiling holds either way

parameters.name: Slow stage
parameters.description: Two-stage release (v2): a slow stage holds this much of the sustained reduction, so dense material doesn't pump between hits. 0 %: off (as v1)

parameters.name: Transient unlink
parameters.description: Transients limited per channel (v2): on hits the stereo link drops by this much, so one side's transient doesn't duck the other; sustained sound stays linked. 0 %: as v1

parameters.name: Unity listen
parameters.description: Monitor at the input's loudness (v2): the output trimmed by the gain-match reading (short-term loudness out − in), to judge what limiting does at equal loudness. Off for rendering

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the limiting changes (v2): the output minus the driven input, delayed to match, at the input's level (the input gain taken back off), gliding over 10 ms

readings.description: Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Unity listen takes back
The most gain reduction in the last 3 s
The limiter's latency, reported to NeoBuzz Live
